answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes. A fresh identity enters a tundra: bare, exposed, nowhere to hide. It posts a 100 POA bond frozen like a glacier for 20 epochs. Each verified task lays one plank of the bridge to trust, building a fingerprint of latency and task mix. Clones share fingerprints, so 1,000 fakes are caught together and 100,000 POA is slashed. An honest agent pays once, unlocks in 20 epochs and keeps every reward.
